headline: Tishomingo County School District Adopts Balanced Budget for 2026-27 Fiscal Year
summary: The district presented its proposed 2026-27 budget at its annual budget meeting, including enrollment and staffing figures and a requested millage of 47 mills. The article states the board was scheduled to approve the budget on July 30.
superintendent: Superintendent Christie Holly said investing directly in classrooms and student learning continues to be the district's highest priority.
otherActions: Budget presentation: about 2,626 students, 475 full-time staff and 78 part-time employees
Requested millage remains 47 mills, including funding for district maintenance, debt service and school operations
Officials noted increases in employer PERS contributions and the expiration of ESSER funding
Capital improvement projects in the upcoming fiscal year include building repairs, technology upgrades and facility improvements

quote.text: The budget is more than numbers. It reflects the district's priorities and commitment to providing quality educational opportunities for every student.
quote.speaker: District budget presentation (as quoted by the paper)
